Validated on energy, chemistry (500k pts), hardware reliability, climate, geochemistry (40,666 igneous rocks). MC-4 (Composition Monitoring) named here as the 4th monitoring category. The cross-AI collective (Claude/ChatGPT/Grok/Gemini/Copilot) did its verification here.
